comment.text: RET M918 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Adrenal gland tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: adrenalgland; Breast tumors; Thyroid tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting RET residue M918 have been observed in thyroid tumors, adrenal gland tumors, and breast tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
